//: Where lessons get published, per machine and per agent.
This is data, not code, because the answer changes every time a provider is
added and nobody should edit a script for that. Paths were measured, not
assumed: opencode's own opencode.jsonc lists which directories it reads, and
the VPS has no ~/.bb/skills because bb's server runs on the Mac.
A directory that does not exist yet is CREATED, not skipped. The point is
that a provider installed tomorrow finds the library already waiting rather
than starting empty — which is what happened to Codex on the VPS.

local.why: Provider-neutral hub. opencode reads it (see opencode.jsonc skills.paths), and it is the right home for anything not tied to one vendor.
Also read by opencode, per its skills.paths.
bb's own user scope. Do not write to ~/.bb/skills-generated — bb owns that.

vps.why: The provider fleet members actually run under on this machine today.
Seeded ahead of need, so opencode or another agent installed here later starts with the library instead of nothing.
